title: Multiline CSV cells expanded into text records

inputs.content:
id,content
l1,"alpha
beta"
l2,gamma
l3,"delta
epsilon
zeta"

turns: Use line_explode to turn each multiline.csv content field into one row per line. Write those lines in source-row and within-row order to lines.txt with the text sink. Every line must be a separate physical output record: no CSV quoting, JSON wrappers or dropped lines. Preserve line lineage in the audit. Validate and preview.

outputs.text:
alpha
beta
gamma
delta
epsilon
zeta

review_policy.constraints: Inspect each presented draft against every explicit requirement in turns. Accept only matching meanings; never approve a changed output, dropped row, weaker type or unrelated requirement. Source data must match supplied input bytes; any model choice must retain the approved sonnet profile.
